title: Cowboys' Stephen Jones insists Joey Porter Jr. is 'all in' despite questionable status for Week 6

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Cowboys' Stephen Jones insists Joey Porter Jr. is 'all in' despite questionable status for Week 6
sources.description: Porter has appeared in one game since being traded to Dallas, raising suspicions he's holding out for a new contract as he did with the Steelers.
